assets.name: evolution-01-sprat
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: mobile underwater action game, pre-rendered 3D-looking 2D fish sprite.
Primary request: one ORIGINAL believable marine predator for a growth/evolution game. The new art should feel like a polished realtime 3D fish model rendered to a sprite: sculpted volume, physically shaded wet skin/scales, translucent fin membranes, subtle natural imperfections, anatomical eye sockets and gill covers. Reference direction is Fish Eat Fish.io's dimensional hungry fish, not a flat graphic mascot.
Camera: nearly direct OVERHEAD looking down on the dorsal back, with a tiny 10-degree view toward the front so the snout and lip volume are visible. The body is perfectly aligned vertically; nose UP, tail DOWN; no sideways pose. Both pectoral fins visible and balanced. Soft directional studio lighting from upper left. Model fills 77 percent of a square canvas height with at least 10 percent true transparent padding.
Anatomical layout mandatory: snout tip at image y=12%, head ends at y=38%, pectoral fin hinges y=43%, narrow tail peduncle y=69%, tail fan y=78..88%. Body width without fins about 30 percent of canvas. Closed jaw with a subtle tooth/lip seam, no open mouth yet. Small realistically sized eyes on the side edges of the head.
Constraints: isolated single complete fish, genuine transparent alpha, no cast shadow or water plane, no bubbles, no glow halo, no text, no logo, no background objects, no outlines or flat cel-shading, no children's-book style, no huge baby eyes, no smile. Keep biological credibility, beautiful skin materials and a strong silhouette. Not a copied existing game character.

Subject: Stage 1 of 6: a small lean juvenile reef sprat. Bronze olive dorsal back, silver-blue flanks, amber gill edge. Delicate transparent gold fins with visible fine fin rays. Short tapered oval head, small black eyes with tiny amber rim, compact forked translucent tail. Fine overlapping fish scales, natural proportions. An ordinary vulnerable little fish, not a cartoon baby.

assets.name: predator-jaw
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an animated mouth overlay for a pre-rendered 3D-looking TOP-DOWN fish sprite in an underwater action mobile game. Exactly one isolated OPEN FISH MOUTH viewed from overhead, tip pointing UP. A broad elongated oval dark navy inner mouth cavity, a curved upper lip at the top and a substantial lower jaw curving around the bottom, two clear rows of small sharp ivory triangular teeth around the inner rim, natural muted blue-gray wet lip skin at the perimeter and deep muted mauve inside. It should resemble the mouth of a hungry marine predator opening upward toward an overhead camera. Realistic sculpted game model render, dimensional but no photoreal photograph, soft left studio highlights, crisp teeth, no thick drawn outlines. Entire mouth fits inside the middle 65 percent of a square canvas, with 15 percent genuine transparent padding. No surrounding fish body, no eye, no head, no fins, no bubbles, no water, no background, no shadow, no text, no glow, no blood or gore. Transparent alpha outside the anatomical mouth outline. This is a functional jaw animation component, not an icon or sticker.

assets.name: lagoon-floor
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square top-down underwater seabed texture for a mobile fish action game. A beautiful natural three-dimensional-looking ocean floor viewed directly from overhead, shallow turquoise blue water over fine pale sand, subtle irregular sandstone shelves, small scattered soft pebbles, darker blue channels near edges and diffuse moving-looking caustic light patterns frozen in the image. High-end stylized-realistic 3D game environment render. Spatially soft and low contrast so moving fish stay clear. The central 65 percent is mostly open sandy water with restrained detail. Cool blue cyan turquoise palette, pale golden light from upper left. Natural material texture, no flat geometric illustration, no outlines, no graphic shapes. Image must fill entire square, reasonably repeatable/mirrorable edges, no vignette or horizon, no fish, no animals, no plants, no interface, no text, no sharp glowing white patterns. Opaque background.

assets.name: reef-garden
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent top-down environment decoration for a stylized-realistic 3D-looking underwater mobile fish game. One compact naturally arranged reef outcrop, viewed directly from above: textured rounded limestone rocks with small realistic branching orange coral, muted purple fan coral, short natural green seaweed and a little pale sand around the rock base. Physically shaded sculpted volume, porous limestone material and translucent coral tips, blue-turquoise underwater ambient light, soft upper-left highlights. Beautiful game-ready 3D render baked into a 2D sprite, not flat drawing, not toy clay, no thick outlines or geometric cartoon shading. Complete cluster isolated with at least 12 percent true transparent alpha padding on every side. No water plane or cast shadow, no baseplate, no fish, faces, eyes, text, bubbles or logos. Only one reef cluster.
